# VAD Emotion Detection System - Final Results

*Final presentation and results coming soon.*

## Project Overview

This project developed an AI-powered emotion detection system using Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) scoring to analyze emotional context in text.

## Key Achievements

- Variance scores >0.70 across all three emotional dimensions
- Over 300,000 labeled text entries
- Real-time emotional tone detection and adaptation

## Applications

- Customer service chatbots
- Mental health monitoring
- Educational tools
- Community moderation
